ValidationRule.description: Regulated projects must be approved, carry at most 3 tags, avoid the Pilot+Strategic combo and have a contact email.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Regulated'), OR( NOT(Is_Approved__c), PICKLISTCOUNT(Tags__c) > 3, AND(INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Pilot'), INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Strategic')), ISBLANK(Contact_Email__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Regulated projects require approval, at most 3 tags, no Pilot+Strategic combo, and a contact email.
